titre: Vacance des commerces américains par format
sous_titre: Taux de vacance en %, premier trimestre 2026

Commerces isolés à locataire unique.texte: Freestanding general retail continued to absorb space positively, adding 0.4 msf on the quarter. With vacancy at just 2.7%

Ensemble du commerce américain.texte: Overall vacancy ticked up to 4.4% from 4.3% in Q4 2025, but the broader picture remains tight by historical standards

Centres commerciaux régionaux.texte: Mall vacancy has now reached 8.8%, reflecting years of structural adjustment
